none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f:E→ℝ with globally L-Lipschitz gradient, L>0. A global minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R, R≥0; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns g(x,Zk) along one stationary, exogenous Markov trajectory. For every fixed x, ∫g(x,z)π(dz)=∇f(x). Conditional unbiasedness at adaptive queries is not assumed. Replies contain only gradient vectors; every oracle call advances the trajectory index.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedMarkovSmoothAndConvex.lean: pathLaw and spec.admissible oracle equality and stationary-gradient identity; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and _run.

distinctive_assumptions.label: markov_dependence
distinctive_assumptions.details: Z0∼π and κπ=π. For every integer t≥0, ∫sup_{A measurable}|κ^t(z,A)−π(A)|π(dz)≤(1+t/τ)^−β, where τ>0 and β>0. This is stationary-average polynomial total-variation mixing, without a uniform-over-states mixing assumption.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedMarkovSmoothAndConvex.lean: mixingDistance, pathLaw, and spec.admissible invariance and mixing inequality.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all x, ∫‖g(x,z)−∇f(x)‖^α π(dz)≤σ^α, with σ≥0 and 1<α≤2. The central moment bound is stationary and uniform in x; for α<2, finite variance is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedMarkovSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible central-moment integrability and inequality.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a complete, second-countable real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure; finite dimensionality is not required. All Params, including L,R,σ,α,τ,β,ε and x0, are public. The objective f and oracle witnesses g,κ,π are hidden. Algorithms may randomize independently of the oracle and must use a fixed oracle-call budget.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedMarkovSmoothAndConvex.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.admissible existential witnesses; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm and Convergence.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X with integrable objective gap f(X)−f(x⋆) for some global minimizer x⋆. No particular iterate or averaging rule is prescribed.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[f(X)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, ε>0, under the joint product law of algorithm randomness and the stationary Markov oracle trajectory.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedMarkovSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.successful and spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex optimization is classical, but this formulation combines stationary finite-α-moment gradient noise with stationary-average polynomial Markov mixing in a potentially infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.
